economy.summary: His campaign says he invested in 21st-century industries, career and technical education, and community colleges, and prioritized affordable housing and expanding childcare.
economy.short: Invested in industries, technical education; prioritizes housing, childcare.

taxes.summary: His campaign says he voted to lower taxes for working families and small businesses.
taxes.short: Says he voted to lower taxes for working families.

abortion.summary: Says medical decisions should be made by women and their doctors, helped defeat an abortion ban amendment, and opposes restrictions on safe, legal abortion, IVF, contraception, and other reproductive healthcare.
abortion.short: Opposes restrictions on abortion, IVF, contraception; defeated ban amendment.

education.summary: Advocates fair funding for public schools and community colleges; his campaign also cites investment in career and technical education.
education.short: Advocates fair funding for public schools and community colleges.

healthcare.summary: Authored House Bill 668 to have Pennsylvania join the National Counseling Compact, allowing licensed counselors from other member states to serve patients across state lines; he cited persistent provider shortages making routine mental health services hard to access.
healthcare.short: Authored bill joining counseling compact to expand mental health access.

energy.summary: His campaign says he protected the state constitutional right to clean air and clean water, holds a 100% pro-environment voting rating, and co-sponsored bipartisan legislation for Bucks County land preservation funding.
energy.short: Cites 100% pro-environment voting record; co-sponsored land preservation.

guns.summary: Introduced legislation to ban guns from polling places to protect voters and election workers, and says he prioritizes public safety through responsible gun violence prevention.
guns.short: Introduced polling-place gun ban; supports gun violence prevention.

economy.summary: Says families are getting hit by high costs and pledges to fight to lower income taxes, lower energy taxes, and stop property tax increases for seniors.
economy.short: Says he will fight high costs by lowering taxes.

taxes.summary: Pledges to fight to lower income taxes, lower energy taxes, and stop property tax increases for seniors.
taxes.short: Proposes lower income and energy taxes; no senior increases.

education.summary: Says he will fight to fully fund local schools and make sure they get their fair share from Harrisburg, and will make sure parents have choices in education.
education.short: Supports fully funding schools and parental choice in education.

guns.summary: His public-safety platform opposes defunding the police and calls for investing in law enforcement and ending sanctuary city and catch-and-release policies; it does not address gun policy specifically.
guns.short: Opposes defunding police; supports investing in law enforcement.
